scope: Development-only axial grasp alternatives after original grasp failed bounded mobile IK. Five declared axial directions per source; original objects and complete source clocks intact. Stop at the first geometrically invalid row while preserving full original arrays and failed configuration. Unvisited rows are not feasible. No physics score or global infeasibility claim.
selection_rank: First declared fully admitted geometry seed; physical outcomes do not rank candidates.
